itemcustomfield.description: v2.1: Manual Net Realizable Value override per pound. Used by SUST_Lib_CostAllocation as the FIRST source in the NRV hierarchical fallback chain. Leave blank to fall through to market-derived / last-sale-based NRV.
itemcustomfield.help: Manual NRV per pound. Used by the cost allocation engine and LCNRV testing. NRV fallback chain: (1) this field, (2) market price x content x recovery, (3) last sale price, (4) zero. Leave blank to use derived NRV. FLOAT not CURRENCY -- $/lb values derived from $/ton figures need 3-4 decimal places.
itemcustomfield.label: NRV per Pound (Manual Override)
